checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: F-35 configuration: one exhaust, two canted tails, no canards
must.why: Jet looks like an F-15/F-22 hybrid with twin engines/two exhausts glowing, three tails visible in some frames, vertical tails look upright.
Frame 1 shows it on the runway, frame 2 lifting off with gear down.
Tail count and look vary (2-3 fins), and the shape shifts between frames.

must.item: All three labels appear exactly and legible
must.why: No on-screen text is visible in any of the sampled frames.

must.item: Narration correct about one engine and conventional takeoff
must.why: Audio exists but the words could not be checked; the visible jet has two exhausts.

faults.what: All requested on-screen labels are missing in the sampled frames.
The aircraft is not an accurate F-35A: it has twin exhausts with afterburner glow, upright F-15-style tails, and an inconsistent number of fins.
The assistant message claims the labels were requested, but none are visible. It also does not mention the jet's twin-engine look.

summary: The clip is a realistic-looking jet taking off and flying, but it looks like a twin-engine F-15/F-22 hybrid rather than an F-35A, and none of the three labels appear.
